attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter bidur-temple
drive car1 bidur-temple trishuli-village
load car1 injured 3
drive car1 trishuli-village bidur-temple
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 bidur-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 injured 3
unload car1 adult 1
drive car2 uttargaya-shelter bidur-temple
load car2 adult 1
drive car2 bidur-temple syaphru-farm
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 syaphru-farm bidur-temple
drive car2 bidur-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car2 elderly 3
unload car2 adult 1
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter kakani-temple
load car1 elderly 3
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 kakani-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 adult 1
defer bidur-temple adult 1
defer kakani-temple adult 3
</plan>
COST: 280

Driving totals 200 minutes (car1 48 + 96, car2 56). Deferred penalties total 80 (4 adults × 20).

Notes on the plan:
- Uttargaya shelter is the only designated safe location, so all rescues end there. Kakani temple is not a drop-off point, so I didn't use it.
- Blocked or unusable roads: Uttargaya–Gajuri (flooded), Uttargaya–Syaphru (closed by police), Galchhi–Trishuli (bridge washed away). Galchhi temple is therefore reachable only via Syaphru farm, and I didn't route anyone through it because it has no stranded people.
- All three injured people and all three elderly people at Syaphru farm are rescued, since their deferral penalties (80 and 50 each) are far higher than the driving cost.
- Only 2 of the 3 adults at Bidur can be carried, because both cars are full with the injured and elderly. Deferring the third costs 20, which is less than a dedicated 34-minute round trip to collect them.
- At Kakani temple, a single 96-minute trip can carry 3 elderly and 1 adult. Deferring the other 3 adults (60) is cheaper than a second trip (96).

Because the plan defers 4 adults, it should be treated as a provisional plan. If more vehicles or time become available, those adults can be collected in a later wave.
